planTitle: Final audit pass against DESIGN.md and regression verification
summary: Updated postcss.config.js to use @tailwindcss/postcss to resolve Vite build errors. Performed final route-by-route audit against DESIGN.md and documented remaining legacy tailwind classes in DESIGN_COMPLIANCE_AUDIT.md as intentional exceptions for density/accessibility. Verified shared primitives effectively enforce the No-Line rule and tonal hierarchy. ESLint passes and Vite build succeeds without errors.
